description: Devflow Skills Marketplace — folder-based skills (each entry is skills/<name>/SKILL.md). Categories are metadata only.

skills.name: recall-before-task
skills.description: Recall relevant memories before starting a task

skills.name: retain-learning
skills.description: Retain a new learning or discovery into Hindsight

skills.name: reflect-session
skills.description: Reflect on the current session and consolidate learnings

skills.name: pre-push-check
skills.description: Run the full pre-push review pipeline before pushing code

skills.name: review
skills.description: Multi-perspective code review of a PR/MR or local diff — parallel agents, confidence scoring, optional draft review comments

skills.name: review-document
skills.description: Multi-perspective prose document review (KB / RFC / spike / runbook / PRD / design / KB page) on Google Docs, Confluence, local files, or arbitrary URLs — parallel agents, comment cross-check, severity scoring, chat-only findings. Counterpart to write-spike.

skills.name: write-spike
skills.description: Write a structured engineering spike / discovery doc for a new initiative — multi-source context assembly, gap classification, diagrams, and a private notes file. Authoring counterpart to review-document.

skills.name: new-feature
skills.description: Start a new feature with worktree, memory recall, and workspace setup

skills.name: finish-feature
skills.description: Finish a feature with checks, an adversarial review gate (re-grounded on the original design doc + ticket ACs, not the plan) plus a deferral-closure gate, then commit, PR, and learning retention

skills.name: create-pr
skills.description: VCS-aware PR/MR creation (GitHub gh / GitLab glab) with self-review, checks, and a structured description (TL;DR, change table, mermaid, honest verification status, no em-dashes); on GitLab it adapts the project's MR template

skills.name: spec-feature
skills.description: Spec a new feature with architecture recall, planning, and task breakdown

skills.name: architecture-decision
skills.description: Document an architectural decision with rationale and memory retention

skills.name: session-summary
skills.description: Generate a session summary for Langfuse tracing and observability

skills.name: trace-review
skills.description: [0.11.0] Per-skill week-over-week Langfuse trace regression report (error rate / latency / cost / score), severity-tagged with exemplar trace links; provider-agnostic scheduler.

skills.name: update-visualizations
skills.description: Analyze recent changes and update affected architecture visualizations

skills.name: visualizations-config
skills.description: Configure visualization location, style presets, and output preferences

skills.name: render-diagram
skills.description: Author + render an Excalidraw diagram (pure-node pipeline, no browser/MCP), show it inline via the Read tool, and embed it in docs — the diagram primitive other skills call

skills.name: dependency-update
skills.description: Check if Brewfile, Formula, or install script need updating when dependencies change

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Extends superpowers:writing-plans with devflow's phase-handoff at the end.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: Devflow wrapper for the upstream brainstorming skill. Thin pass-through that lets callers invoke /devflow:brainstorming as the single canonical entry point — never reach past it to the upstream skill directly.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Devflow wrapper for the upstream executing-plans skill. Delegates the per-task red-green-refactor loop to the upstream flow but intercepts the terminal handoff so it goes to /devflow:finish-feature instead of the upstream finishing-a-development-branch.

skills.name: lock-tests
skills.description: Lock the full test inventory before any implementation code is written — writes failing tests, emits a Test Inventory doc, and gates with user approval.

skills.name: phase-handoff
skills.description: Hand off between phases of the devflow new-feature pipeline — writes a frozen-state file, marks a chapter, sets terminal title, gates on a one-click AskUserQuestion, then spawns a new Claude Desktop session via mcp__ccd_session__spawn_task titled [<TICKET>] [MR#<N>] <Phase>.

skills.name: best-roi-task
skills.description: Find the best ROI task in a Jira Epic — highest points for least effort, unassigned To Do only

skills.name: codebase-walkthrough
skills.description: Deep codebase walkthrough before implementation — trace the full flow and build understanding

skills.name: resolve-repo
skills.description: Resolve the correct repository for a task — detect VCS platform, match ticket to repo, clone if missing

skills.name: task-complete
skills.description: Mark a devflow task as done — update status, move to done/ folder, and retain learnings

skills.name: task-prioritize
skills.description: Reprioritize a devflow task — move between priority folders (P0-P4) and update frontmatter

skills.name: verify-first
skills.description: Ground-truth every technical AND requirement-coverage claim against the source of truth before relying on it. Run the probe; for requirements, diff the plan against the original design doc + ticket — neither docs nor the plan are verification.

skills.name: readable-doc
skills.description: Format a plan/spike/design doc for fast scannable plannotator review (TLDR-first, status circles, GFM-alert callouts, compact emoji tables, collapsibles, considered-but-rejected, two mandated diagrams)

skills.name: readable-doc-spike
skills.description: Format a full engineering spike/PRD/design-of-record into the team-standard shape (metadata header, TLDR, goals, architecture diagrams, per-goal investigation, options+recommendation, considered-but-rejected, DB/GraphQL/query changes, migration, deps, testing, effort, phasing, feature-flag, risks, open questions, verification appendix)
